items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: if you're working for Jim Jones you ask Jim Jones for the money.

ctx.x: No-one told me, right. You know, if you're working for Jim Jones you ask Jim Jones for the money. But this is big time. He had a manager.

Well, anyway, to make a story, that's the way it happened, and of course it went down and we played the six weeks at the Paramount Theater, which was real beautiful, real fine.
